title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom applying for a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent academic qualification
description: Full-cost scholarship for outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Software Engineering Internship 2025
location: Mountain View, CA, USA / Various Locations
eligibility: Students currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Computer Science or related technical field
qualification: Pursuing a degree in CS, STEM, or equivalent practical experience
description: A 12-to-14 week summer internship where students work on real-world engineering projects alongside full-time Googlers to solve complex technical problems.

title: Junior Software Engineer
eligibility: Global candidates with strong software engineering fundamentals and interest in open-source systems
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM, or equivalent experience
description: Work remotely on open-source infrastructure projects, Linux distributions (Ubuntu), cloud technology, and distributed systems architecture.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with less than 2 years of product management experience
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in any technical, design, or analytical discipline
description: A rotational product management program designed to train future product leaders through hands-on experience driving key initiatives across Meta products.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students and self-learners worldwide without prior programming experience
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan that teaches how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school, university, or higher education institutions globally
salary: Grand Prize: $100,000 USD + Mentorship with Microsoft CEO
description: Global student technology competition empowering the next generation of founders to build innovative startups using Microsoft Azure AI technologies.
